name: WWII Online
description: This benchmark evaluates large-scale combined-arms warfare in a persistent first-person MMO set in WWII. It tests tactical combat, logistics, squad coordination, and high-command strategic decisions across ground, air, and naval forces.
reputation: Pioneering and longest-running massively multiplayer WWII simulation with a dedicated veteran player community
notes: Massive persistent world driven entirely by players; exceptional test of real-time team coordination and historical warfare simulation
